videos.title: UX Animations
videos.why: A four-minute demonstration of why animation timing matters, showing how both too slow and too fast make an interface harder to use.

videos.title: Designing Meaningful Animation - Val Head - btconfDUS 2016
videos.why: A longer talk on borrowing motion design principles such as timing, offsets and secondary action for interface decisions.

podcasts.episode: #133 Animation and Fairytale UX with Val Head & Per Axbom
podcasts.why: Two short interviews recorded at UXLx, with Val Head on animating interfaces and Per Axbom on when a little friction serves people better.

podcasts.episode: Animation for Better UX:  a Chat with Val Head
podcasts.why: Val Head on how interface animation has changed since the Flash days into a real tool for better experiences, drawing on her book Designing Interface Animation.

reads.title: Executing UX Animations: Duration and Motion Characteristics
reads.why: The practical numbers for how long transitions should last and which easing to use for elements entering and leaving the screen, with the reasons.

reads.title: Great Animations
reads.why: A design engineer's checklist for animations that feel fast and natural, with live demos you can poke at.

reads.title: Designing Safer Web Animation For Motion Sensitivity
reads.why: Which kinds of movement make some people feel ill, and how to offer a reduced-motion version without losing meaning.
